mapper.select: SELECT uah.* FROM user_account_history uah JOIN user_account ua ON uah.user_uid = ua.uid ${ew.sqlSegment}

SELECT u.*, r.id user_role_id, r.user_id, r.role_id, r.role_type FROM user_account u JOIN user_role r ON u.ID = r.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role sr ON sr.ID = r.role_Id AND ( sr.NAME != 'Guest' OR sr.NAME != 'ClinicalStaff' OR sr.NAME != 'ActivationPerson' ) WHERE u.ID > 0 AND u.tenant_uid = #{tenantUid} AND ( u.is_disable = FALSE OR u.is_disable IS NULL ) AND ( u.is_deleted = FALSE OR u.is_deleted IS NULL )
